name: ai-laboratory
vibe: A dark neural-research-lab film. On a deep near-black ground, a living network of glowing nodes and connections pulses and fires signals behind every scene, with a slow HUD scanline, corner brackets and a vignette flowing unbroken across every cut. A model boots and ignites, a prompt tokenizes into latent space, a neural network builds and fires, frames synthesize from retracting scanlines, a scientific HUD reads out telemetry, screenshots appear as holographic panels in the network, and converging nodes assemble into a logo-reveal CTA. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole lab — the lattice glow, the edges, the node fill, the panels, the gradient headlines and the CTA, not just the text. Electric accent glow over deep near-black. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for AI/ML products, research launches, developer tools, data platforms and anything that should feel scientific, generative and cutting-edge.
